address: Kirchweg 2, Sankt Veit im Pongau, 5621, Austria
bio: This modern Alpine tavern is a wonderful alternative to the fine dining restaurant here at Hotel Sonnenhof. Windows between the two dining areas foster a nice and airy feel and mean there is a view of the magnificent mountain landscape from almost every table. The tastefully designed upscale interior with a hint of rusticity is the perfect setting in which to enjoy a contemporary take on Wirtshausküche (tavern cuisine) based on select, mostly regional ingredients. Think Alpine fish soup – paprika fish soup, Alpine prawns, fennel agnolotti or Pongauer Fleischkrapfen (meat and sauerkraut dumplings), coleslaw, bacon chips, chives.
